title: Wat Phra That Choeng Chum
geometryBasis: Named mapped square stupa, neighboring four-arm prayer hall footprint, exact cleared Qualla photo and published Thai heritage architectural dimensions.
sectionBasis: The 24 m square Lan Xang stupa has a multi-level white plaster base, ornate portals and a tapering gilt upper spire. The east hall has orange glazed roofs with green borders and its southern gable fronts the same open court.
limitations: The exterior model covers the standing stupa and its photographed eastern viharn. The older separate ordination hall and wider compound are outside this asset scope.
The spire divisions, relief work and ceramic roof ornaments use photographic proportions.
